eras.name: The Silent Era
eras.blurb: Hand-cranked cameras, title cards and nickel theatres. Nobody is sure moving pictures will last.

eras.name: The Golden Age of Sound
eras.blurb: Pictures learn to talk, then to sing, then to burst into colour. Studios become dream factories.

eras.name: The Blockbuster Era
eras.blurb: Television has changed everything. Young directors, location shooting and summer event films take over.
